groups.title: 1. Platform, identity and sites
groups.desc: Users, roles, labels, sites, remote locations and system configuration.

groups.title: 3. Schema and templates
groups.desc: Schemas, schema templates, schema sites, and NDO templates (mso_template).

groups.title: 4. VRF
groups.desc: Template and site-local VRFs, VRF contracts, regions, CIDRs and route leak.

groups.title: 5. Bridge domains
groups.desc: Template and site-local bridge domains, subnets and BD-to-L3Out associations.

groups.title: 6. ANP and EPG
groups.desc: Application Network Profiles, EPGs, contracts on EPGs, selectors, subnets, uSeg attributes, domains and static leaf or port bindings.

groups.title: 7. Contracts, filters and external EPGs
groups.desc: Contracts, filter entries, contract filters, external EPGs, contracts and selectors.

groups.title: 8. L3Out
groups.desc: Schema-template L3Outs. Tenant-policy L3Out routing policies live with tenant policy templates.

groups.title: 9. Service graphs and devices
groups.desc: Service node types, service graphs, contract service-graph associations, service chaining and service device clusters.

groups.title: 10. Tenant policy templates
groups.desc: Tenant policies: DHCP, QoS, IPSLA, IGMP/MLD, route maps, match and set rules, NetFlow, L3Out routing policies and endpoint tags.

groups.title: 11. Fabric policy and resource templates
groups.desc: Fabric policies (VLAN pools, domains, interface, node and PTP/MCP/syncE settings) and fabric resource interfaces (physical, PC, vPC).

groups.title: 12. Validate, deploy and utility
groups.desc: Schema template deploy (including the NDO deploy resource), REST utility.
